title: May el-Toukhy Takes ‘Woman Unknown’ to Venice: “I’ve Used Every Part of Me to Make This Film”
summary: The Danish filmmaker, one of two female directors in competition this year, comes to the Lido with a feature following a woman about to marry her widowed employer in the aftermath of World War II — while harboring a secret.

title: Wim Wenders on His 14-Year Journey Building Peter Zumthor Doc ‘From Inside Out’
summary: The Oscar-nominated director of 'Pina' and 'The Salt of the Earth' returns to 3D for 'From Inside Out: The Architecture of Peter Zumthor,' a portrait of the Pritzker-winning architect behind LACMA's $724 million David Geffen Galleries — and a defense of beauty in a world of flattened cities.

title: ‘The Debut’ Review: Julianne Moore and Paul Giamatti Are Dynamite Together in Jesse Eisenberg’s Entertainingly Offbeat Theater Comedy
summary: Premiering at Telluride, the film follows a meek New Jersey housewife who gets cast in a local production headed by a domineering director, and then increasingly loses herself in the role.

title: ‘A Tale of Two Cities’ Review: Kit Harington Has Done Far, Far Better Things Than This Bland MGM+ Dickens Adaptation
summary: The 'Game of Thrones' star and François Civil fight for the affections of Mirren Mack in a new four-episode adaptation of the classic novel.

title: Mariska Hargitay Lands Two Emmys for ‘My Mom Jayne’ Ahead of Hosting Gig
summary: The star, who is emceeing the Primetime Emmys on Sept. 14, took home two prizes at the Creative Arts ceremony, two decades after winning an Emmy for 'SVU.'

title: Creative Arts Emmys, Night One: Winners List
summary: 'The Late Show With Stephen Colbert,' 'The Muppet Show,' 'The Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show Starring Bad Bunny' and 'My Mom Jayne: A Film By Mariska Hargitay' were among the big winners.

title: Alan Cumming Lands Third Straight Emmy for Best Reality TV Host
summary: 'The Traitors' host was honored at the Creative Arts Emmys on Saturday.

title: Alanis Morissette Sues Former Tour Manager Over Alleged “Calculated Blackmail Campaign”
summary: The Grammy winner was previously embezzled by her former manager Jonathan Todd Schwartz. He admitted to embezzling more than $7 million from Morissette and other celebrity clients in 2017.

title: Ben McKenzie Says He’d “Be Up for” a ‘The O.C.’ Revival: “It Was a Great Show”
summary: The former 'Gotham' star's comments come nearly 20 years after the Fox teen drama ended after four seasons.

title: ‘The Debut’ Features Seven Original Songs, All Written by Jesse Eisenberg, and One Is Getting an Oscar Push (Exclusive)
summary: The best original song race already includes tunes by Taylor Swift, Travis Scott, David Byrne, Backstreet Boys and, yes, Diane Warren.
